lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-002 (CAM-388 review round 2) fixed the reviewer's WARNING finding at prd-oracle-lint.ts:292: stripQuotedSpans blanked EVERY non-`-c` quoted span whole (replaced with a single space), including a DOUBLE-quoted `$(...)` command substitution that is not a `-c` wrapper -- but per POSIX Shell Command Language 2.2.3, double quotes suppress word-splitting of a command substitution's result, not the substitution itself, so `"$(cmd)"` still executes `cmd` regardless of the surrounding quotes. The reviewer's exact repro, `test $(wc -l < "$(git show main:f.ts)") -eq 42`, had its `git show main:` derivation token destroyed by the blanket blank-out before LIVE_DERIVATION_RE ever ran, so hasFrozenIntegerComparand false-positived (main=ok, branch=flag) -- confirmed empirically before the fix. Fix: added findCommandSubstitutionEnd (balanced-paren depth scan, split out from extractCommandSubstitutionSpans to stay under Biome's cognitive-complexity ceiling of 15) and extractCommandSubstitutionSpans (walks content, preserves every top-level `$(...)` span verbatim, blanks everything else); stripQuotedSpans now special-cases a non-wrapper DOUBLE-quoted span to call extractCommandSubstitutionSpans on its content instead of blanking it whole. A non-wrapper SINGLE-quoted span is unaffected (still fully blanked -- `'$(cmd)'` performs zero expansion in real shell, so it stays genuinely inert), and a `-c` wrapper span of either quote style is unaffected (still recursively unwrapped via stripQuotedSpans, unchanged from US-001/US-R1-001/US-R2-001). Corrected two false/superseded docs claims per the reviewer's explicit instruction: the hasFrozenIntegerComparand docstring (was: 'a derivation token that legitimately lives inside quotes still excuses the comparand' -- now precisely scoped to -c-wrapper payloads and double-quoted $(...) substitutions, NOT quoted inert text) and the scripts/cam/patterns.md US-001 bullet's claim 'Both regexes must run against the SAME stripped string, or a live-derivation token living inside quotes would stop excusing a comparand' (added an inline correction note pointing at the new dedicated US-R2-002 bullet). Added one new fixture row to test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt reproducing the reviewer's exact command (labeled 'ok', i.e. correctly NOT flagged after the fix). Verified: manual bun -e repro of the reviewer's exact command plus 4 pre-existing representative fixture rows (2 ok / 2 flag) all classify correctly pre-commit; bun test prd-oracle-lint.test.ts 58/58 pass; full bun run check:all spine green (5230/5230 tests, embed-vendor ok, lint clean after refactoring extractCommandSubstitutionSpans to fix a Biome cognitive-complexity-17>15 violation by extracting the balanced-paren scan into findCommandSubstitutionEnd, file-size ok, debt-markers ok, version-skips ok, coverage ok, dead-code ok, dup ok, ci-parity ok, agents-md ok, test-sleeps ok). No external library touched (pure internal regex/TS logic); Step 5.5 recorded as no_external_lib_touched. scripts/cam/prd.json is not edited by this story per the 'supervisor is sole writer of passes' rule.
